description: The composite-expression guard (qmf.risk.performance.FORBIDDEN_COMPOSITE_EXPRESSIONS, invoked from the public Epic-19 surface qmb.results.measures.emit_measure via PerformanceMeasure.try_create) does not reject a 'grade'-named composite ('grade','overall_grade','letter_grade') and does not reject an underscore/space-spelled weighted composite ('weighted_aggregate'); the set's hyphenated members ('weighted-aggregate','tier-band','composite-score') only substring-match hyphenated identities, and neither 'grade' nor 'aggregate' nor bare 'weighted' is a token. AC19.2/R-RPT-10/DEC-0162 name 'grade' and 'weighted rating/aggregate' as composites that may never express a result. emit_measure is exported, so such a composite measure can be minted and stored, under-enforcing the epic's centre-of-gravity negative. Root cause is the qmf-risk vocabulary (Epic 10, Story 10.10); flagged here because R13 is Epic-19-owned and the pinned V1 roster's cleanliness relies on this guard.
expected: emit_measure / PerformanceMeasure.try_create returns a POLICY_REJECTION for any measure identity naming a composite the AC forbids, including 'grade' and 'weighted_aggregate'.
observed: emit_measure('overall_grade'|'letter_grade'|'grade'|'weighted_aggregate', money, unit_kind='money(currency)') returns Ok(PerformanceMeasure(...)) — accepted and storable; only 'weighted_composite' is caught, incidentally via the 'composite' substring.
